name: Recital AB
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the Baltic Sea and ways forward
part_text: AB. whereas many Baltic Sea Member States have introduced individual transferable quota systems (ITQs) as available under the CFP; whereas this has favoured large operators, in particular large industrial vessels, which account for a disproportionate share of total Baltic Sea catch volumes relative to their number; whereas such a concentration of fishing opportunities marginalises the small and medium-scale family enterprises that constitute the social and economic backbone of Baltic coastal communities; whereas the impact on stock structure is primarily determined by the gear and fishing techniques used; whereas the ecological sensitivity and specific socio-economic structure of the Baltic Sea warrant differentiated management of fishing access based on vessel size and operational capacity;
